_about: Product SEO descriptions for the glutathione serum and the Brightening & Glow Duo, 2026-09-23. The live descriptions promised 'a more even-looking tone' and 'a softer look of dark spots' (serum) and 'a brighter, even tone' (Duo); neither outcome was measured in the only controlled trial of topical GSSG (docs/claims/glutathione.md §2). Titles unchanged. Translations in claims-glutathione-products-2026-09-23.descriptions.translations.json.
